statement.p: A painting is on sale at {\$525.00}. Its original price was {\$750.00}. What percentage is this off its original price?
The painting was off its original price.

solution.p: The price changed from {\$750.00} to {\$525.00}, implying the markdown was {\$750.00} - {\$525.00} = {\$225.00}.
Now this problem can be boiled down to this question: 225 is what percent of 750? We will show multiple methods to solve this problem.
We will use proportion to solve this problem.
Assume 225 is x\% of 750, so x out of 100 corresponds to 225 out of 750.
We will write and solve the proportion:
The painting was 30\% off its original price.
We will use the percentage formula to solve this problem.
This translation from English to may should help you remember the percentage formula.
Assume 225 is x (as a percent) of 750. We have:
The painting was 30\% off its original price.
In the sentence 225 is what percent of 750,

li.p: 750 is the base (following the word of).

solution.p: By the formula \text{rate} = \frac{\text{percentage}}{\text{base}}, we do a division to solve the problem:
The painting was 30\% off its original price.
